title: Before the First Edit? Measuring When Coding-Agent Guidance Actually Arrives
abstract: arXiv:2610.35992v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a coding-agent harness promises guidance before the first source edit, what event does it actually intercept? We audit five separate events: policy assignment, request eligibility, trigger, plan delivery, and observed source-content change. A prescribed-action comparison exposes the coverage of three gate rules but cannot tell us how an agent would continue after receiving a plan. We therefore run local agents on public software issues and hash Python files before and after each executed action. In a pilot-guided, 76-arm study using Qwen2.5-Coder 14B, 15 arms change Python source across seven tasks and three repositories. Guidance precedes every observed first change, but every change uses a structured editor and the study misses its prespecified 20-arm coverage target. Post hoc local tests find seven changed arms that pass the tested target and regression selectors; four of those seven use incomplete regression lists. Public PAUSE

translated_title: 首次编辑之前？测量编码代理指导实际到达的时机
translated_abstract: 当编码代理框架承诺在首次源代码编辑之前提供指导时，它实际拦截的是哪个事件？我们审查了五个独立的事件：策略分配、请求资格、触发、计划交付以及观察到的源内容变更。规定动作比较揭示了三种门控规则的覆盖范围，但无法告诉我们代理在收到计划后会如何继续。因此，我们在公开软件议题上运行本地代理，并在每个执行动作前后对Python文件进行哈希。在一项以试点为指导、使用Qwen2.5-Coder 14B的76个分支研究中，有15个分支在七个任务和三个代码库中改变了Python源代码。指导先于每一次观察到的首次变更，但每次变更都使用了结构化编辑器，且该研究未达到预设的20个分支覆盖目标。事后本地测试发现七个变更分支通过了测试目标和回归选择器；其中四个使用了不完整的回归列表。公开暂停（PAUSE）
tldr: 该研究通过审查五个事件并在代理每个执行动作前后对Python文件进行哈希，测量编码代理在首次源代码编辑前的指导实际到达时机，发现指导确实先于所有观察到的首次变更，但研究未达到预设的20个分支覆盖目标。
en_tdlr: By auditing five separate events and hashing Python files before and after each executed agent action, this study measures when coding-agent guidance actually arrives before the first source edit, finding that guidance precedes every observed first change, though the study misses its prespecified 20-arm coverage target.
